video_title: Cason Wallace On OKC Thunder’s 2025 NBA Championship & Playing With Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the importance of checking egos in the locker room
quotes.excerpt: when you step foot to the door of this franchise, go ahead and drop your ego

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: So basically, when you step foot to the door of this franchise, go ahead and drop your ego right here before you walk through these doors.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on how the OKC Thunder's culture influences other teams
quotes.excerpt: you're seeing some college teams do that, you're seeing some high school teams do that

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: And that's what I was going to say, which has set the tone what you see now in college and some high schools. When you guys do post-game interviews, it's the entire team, everybody around having a good time. You get to be a part of this crew. From what you're talking about that brotherhood, you see that in the post-game, which is now bleeding into college. You're seeing some college teams do that, you're seeing some high school teams do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: Yeah, it's funny because some people love it and some people hate it. And it's just like we're a group of big kids, really. We say it all the time, we're a big AAU team.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the benefits of the OKC Thunder's team-first culture
quotes.excerpt: you're a coach's dream because that lets you know you'll never have to worry about your team

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: But I think you're a coach's dream because that lets you know you'll never have to worry about your team not being together. And through the good and bad times, you notice even when you guys lose games, you don't see a couple guys just walking off the court. No, you dap up, come on man, we win, we lose together.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the surreal experience of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: just to know that that little kid is here in this present moment, about to have his first
quotes.quote: It was like everybody say a dream come true, but it's more than that, it's deeper than that. Just knowing that you worked your whole life since a little kid, well for myself, I've always had dreams and wrote them down. I'm in elementary school writing on my history papers, my school work, I'm in the NBA winning championships. And just to know that that little kid is here in this present moment, about to have his first NBA championship, it was like it's deeper than a dream come true, you know? It's like you can't even put it in words, but an amazing feeling just knowing that we did it and it was so early in my career.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the difficulty of the Denver and Indiana playoff series
quotes.excerpt: it was close between between Denver and Indiana for sure
quotes.quote: It was close between between Denver and Indiana for sure. Indiana, that was our first time making it that far into the season. So mentally, it's like okay, we got to keep pushing. We just lost this game pretty bad, we got to shake back. But Denver is like going up against Nikola Jokic, a great team, a lot of pieces. We're going to Denver and the altitude is a real thing and the crowds are crazy, but between those two, we know that Indiana is a team that won't give up and they've made insane plays throughout every series.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the mental burden of missing a game-winning shot
quotes.excerpt: when you're you see him knock that that shot down and he gets to win, what goes through your mind

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Let me paint this picture. So you talked about getting there. Now you're playing in the NBA Finals that year, Game 1 happens. And Buddy Hield hits that that game winner, what goes through your mind when you're you see him knock that that shot down and he gets to win?

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: I was upset for sure because one, it was on me and two, it was one of those plays that I just explained, like they're going to make one of those shots each series and it's happened every single time. So I just hated that it was on me and that it even happened in the first place.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the defensive challenge of guarding Buddy Hield
quotes.excerpt: he shoots a shot that in my opinion, I don't feel like he wanted to shoot for real
quotes.quote: Trying to keep him from scoring and he shoots a shot that in my opinion, I don't feel like he wanted to shoot for real. He got there, of course he shot it and made it and he's capable, but I didn't feel like when he went up to shoot it that he was confident in taking it. He was like it's either going to go in or it's not, you know, and of course it went in.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his mental adjustment between playoff games
quotes.excerpt: I gave him a shot that he's comfortable like the film says and his stats say
quotes.quote: After the game, of course I let it sink in like, yo you got to be better. That was the only thing that went to my mind, I got to be better. Then we go through the film and it's like okay, I gave him a shot that he's comfortable like the film says and his stats say that he's comfortable shooting. Going right to the wing, that's the shot that he's consistently makes. And in the moment I'm thinking like he doesn't really want to shoot that shot, but I go back and I watch the film and it's like okay, I got to be better in that. I could have did something differently.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on learning from playing alongside an MVP
quotes.excerpt: when you get the opportunity to play with a freaking MVP, bro, there's so much you can learn
quotes.quote: For me, it's when you get the opportunity to play with a freaking MVP, bro, there's so much you can learn from a guy that reaches that level of basketball and you've been blessed, you know, to be right there with Shai for so many years. Talk about that experience playing alongside Shai and what have you learned, you know, playing with somebody that has reached that level?

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's unmatched confidence and self-talk
quotes.excerpt: his confidence and his self-talk is unmatched
quotes.quote: His confidence and his self-talk is unmatched. Like as Vince you were saying earlier, like if you miss a shot or if something doesn't go your way, how do you respond? His response is like I got to keep keep doing that. I don't care how many times I miss it, I don't care I don't care. I know I can make it. Yeah, like I'm going to keep shooting it until I make it. And it's in game and it's like okay, like go crazy, bro.
